title: MSFS Marketplace Update: VirtualCol CRJ & 737-8 MAX Liveries Review
description:
Are you looking to expand your Microsoft Flight Simulator airliner fleet this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the virtual storefront? Today, we are breaking down a focused commercial aviation marketplace drop featuring regional jet operations and global mainline livery customization.

To find out what's worth your hard-earned money, we dive deep into the latest releases featuring the VirtualCol FS Software CRJ NG Series (CRJ-700, CRJ-900, and CRJ-1000) for MSFS 2020—a beginner-friendly, casual regional airliner package offering 33 HD liveries, animated wing flex, custom sounds, and an EFB tablet for quick starts. Alongside it, we examine the 2Pilot 737-8 World Liveries Pack, bringing 35 high-resolution global carrier schemes (including KLM, Lufthansa, United, Delta, Emirates, and Virgin Australia) to the newly released Boeing 737-8 MAX platform at an active launch discount.

Whether you need a relaxed, low-cost jet for short regional hops or want to dress up your 737-8 MAX in your favorite airline colors, we evaluate the visuals, system depth, and overall value proposition to help you decide what deserves a spot in your virtual hangar.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below letting us know what's in your hangar! Are you picking up the CRJ or refreshing your 737-8 fleet?
